# BTCDecoded

> Cited search over Bitcoin’s public coordination record (Intelligence), plus the BLVM full node. Same chain as Bitcoin Core — not a new coin.

BTCDecoded’s **main offering** is [Intelligence](https://btcdecoded.org/intelligence/): a cited index of IRC, mailing lists, GitHub, Delving, Bitcointalk, Satoshi, BIPs, and Core source (~759k contemporaneous passages) plus a curated ~28k passages of specs, maps, textbooks, research, academic papers, Nostr NIPs, Stratum V2, Lightning extras, and tooling docs. Pay with Lightning. Connect over MCP at `https://mcp.btcdecoded.org/mcp`. Claude uses OAuth; Cursor and other clients use a Bearer key. Sign in with GitHub or Nostr, then pay on this site so the key stays on the account.

The **node** is [BLVM](https://btcdecoded.org/install/): a Bitcoin full node with the consensus rules written down. Normative spec lives on [thebitcoincommons.org](https://thebitcoincommons.org); operator docs on [docs.thebitcoincommons.org](https://docs.thebitcoincommons.org).

## Intelligence

- [Overview](https://btcdecoded.org/intelligence/): What is in the index
- [Recap vs the Passage](https://btcdecoded.org/assets/intelligence-recap.mp4): 3:37 homepage recap on the Intelligence card
- [Agent spec](https://btcdecoded.org/intelligence/llms.txt): Layers, sources, roles, retrieval rules, MCP
- [Agent skill](https://btcdecoded.org/intelligence/SKILL.md): Actor, precedent, spec verdict, App comment, cite URIs, snapshots
- [MCP server](https://mcp.btcdecoded.org/mcp): Streamable HTTP. OAuth for Claude; Bearer key for Cursor and raw HTTP
- [Plans](https://btcdecoded.org/pricing/): Trial 15k sats / 7 days / 50 queries per day; Researcher 250 qpd; Developer 500 qpd plus public GitHub PR review, advisory spec checks over Bearer MCP (`analyze_submission`), and cited retrieval tools
- [Checkout](https://btcdecoded.org/subscribe/): Lightning. Same key on upgrade (sat difference only). Referral links use `?plan=trial&ref=`; cannot combine with a coupon
- [Account](https://btcdecoded.org/account/): GitHub or Nostr login, Claude OAuth fields, Bearer key, client config snippets, and a referral share link / credit
- [Support](https://btcdecoded.org/support/): Form emails support@btcdecoded.org. Intelligence billing, keys, checkout, and general help
- [Terms](https://btcdecoded.org/terms/): Lightning plans, accounts, MCP use
- [Privacy](https://btcdecoded.org/privacy/): Account, GitHub App, and live-only private review
- [Third-party services](https://btcdecoded.org/third-party/): GitHub, Cloudflare, Lightning, MCP clients
- [Security](https://btcdecoded.org/security/): GitHub App bounds, data governance, no audit reports
- [Security contact](mailto:security@thebitcoincommons.org)

## Node (BLVM)

- [Install BLVM](https://btcdecoded.org/install/): Current release packages, checksums, Docker, release history
- [Pre-built nodes](https://btcdecoded.org/plugandplay/): Start9, Umbrel, myNode, Parmanode
- [Why BLVM?](https://btcdecoded.org/whyblvm/): One spec, Z3-backed verification, Core differential
- [FAQ](https://btcdecoded.org/faq/): Consensus safety and operator questions

## Spec and project

- [Problem](https://btcdecoded.org/problem/): Informal process vs a written spec
- [Architecture](https://btcdecoded.org/architecture/): BLVM crate map
- [Orange Paper (on-site intro)](https://btcdecoded.org/orangepaper/): Orientation; canonical math IR is off-site
- [Governance](https://btcdecoded.org/governance/): Live YAML viewer and Commons enforcement
- [Orange Paper (canonical)](https://thebitcoincommons.org/orange-paper.html)
- [Consensus Spec register](https://thebitcoincommons.org/spec.html)
- [BLVM documentation book](https://docs.thebitcoincommons.org/introduction.html)
- [blvm releases](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases)
